question: From Tables 3 and 7, how much lighter is the multilayer crystal with both layers at 400 °C than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C?
rendered:
To find the answer, we need to compare the mass of the multilayer crystal with both layers at 400 °C (Table 7) to the mass of the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C (Table 3). 

The mass of the multilayer crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 2.947 g (Table 7). 
The mass of the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C is 1.118 g (Table 3).

The difference in mass is 2.947 g - 1.118 g = 1.829 g.
